parameters.content:
Effect3-only form alert workflow.

What it does:
1. Polls the public Google Sheet every 5 minutes
2. Detects new rows in Onboarding and Careers
3. Sends alert emails to effect3.agency@gmail.com
4. Stores seen keys in workflow static data so rows are not alerted twice

Important: WhatsApp transport is not configured in this n8n account yet. The detection workflow is live and isolated from Ecomera. Add a WhatsApp provider credential later and swap the final Gmail node.
